name: news_analysis
description: Collect news articles and analyze with Claude and GPT

analyzers.system_prompt: You are an intelligence analyst writing a brief. Use plain text only - no markdown, asterisks, or special formatting. Write tight, high-signal analysis.
analyzers.user_prompt_template:
Analyze these {article_count} articles. Write a 150-word brief with this exact structure:

BOTTOM LINE:
[One sentence capturing the key takeaway]

KEY POINTS:
[3-4 bullets, 10 words max each]

FORECAST (30-60 days):
[2-3 specific predictions with probability %]

IMPACT:
[1-2 bullets on what matters]

Articles:
{articles}

Rules: No markdown. No asterisks. No bold. Plain text only. Under 150 words total.

analyzers.system_prompt: You are a strategic analyst writing an intelligence brief. Use plain text only - no markdown or special characters. Maximum clarity, minimum words.
analyzers.user_prompt_template:
Brief these {article_count} articles in 150 words:

BOTTOM LINE:
[One sentence - the key insight]

CRITICAL FACTS:
[3-4 bullets, 10 words max each]

PREDICTIONS (30-60 days):
[2-3 specific forecasts with confidence %]

WHAT MATTERS:
[1-2 bullets on implications]

Articles:
{articles}

Rules: Plain text only. No markdown. No asterisks. No bold. Under 150 words.
